# StillsDrift

> StillsDrift is a free photo-to-video app for your phone. It turns a few photos into a short moving video for Reels, Stories and Shorts. It works offline, needs no account, and never uploads your photos. Currently in testing on Android; an iPhone version is planned. Made by REISS STUDIO, professional photographers.

## Key facts

- Styles: Scrolling Columns, Photo Wall, Slideshow
- Formats: 9:16 (Reels, Stories, Shorts), 1:1, 16:9
- Pace: calm, balanced or lively; mark the main subject so every move keeps it in the frame
- Free version: every style and tool, up to 3 photos, 720p, small watermark. A Plus version with more photos is coming
- Private: the video is made on the phone, nothing is uploaded, works offline, no account
